import threading
import time
from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest

from captain_hook.snapshots import worker
from captain_hook.snapshots.worker import Owner, empty_usage, failure
from tests.test_snapshot_owner import context, request

CLASSIFIER = {"id": "native", "version": "1"}


def owner_answering(statuses):
    calls = []

    def native(body, *, context, cancellation):
        calls.append((body, context, cancellation))
        status = statuses.pop(0)
        if status == "ok":
            return {**failure(body["id"], "ok", ""), "status": "ok", "complete": True, "usage": empty_usage()}
        return failure(body["id"], status, "fixture")

    owner = object.__new__(Owner)
    owner.store = SimpleNamespace(register_tool_registry=lambda registry, *, context: "fixture", request=native)
    owner.incomplete_type = type("SnapshotIncomplete", (Exception,), {})
    owner.registry_generations = {}
    owner.registry_guard = threading.Lock()
    owner.graph_misses = worker.LRUDict(worker.MAX_GRAPH_MISSES)
    return owner, calls


def prepare(frame_id, thread_ids=("thread-a", "thread-b")):
    return request(
        frame_id,
        operation="prepare_graph",
        view={"handle": f"lease-{frame_id}", "classifier": CLASSIFIER, "selectors": [], "attachments": []},
        thread_ids=list(thread_ids),
        roots=["/codex/sessions"],
        direct_paths=[],
        active_since_unix_ms=frame_id,
        deadline_unix_ms=time.time_ns() // 1_000_000 + 750,
    )["snapshot"]["request"]


def test_owner_passes_each_graph_request_to_native_as_its_window_moves(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(worker.time, "monotonic", lambda: 100.0)
    owner, calls = owner_answering(["deadline", "deadline", "deadline", "ok", "deadline"])
    assert owner.call(prepare(1), context(), object(), [])["status"] == "deadline"
    assert owner.call(prepare(2), context(), object(), [])["status"] == "deadline"
    assert [body["id"] for body, _, _ in calls] == ["request-1", "request-2"], "GRAPH_DEADLINE_REPLAY_PREVENTED_PROGRESS"
    assert owner.call(prepare(3, ("thread-c",)), context(), object(), [])["status"] == "deadline"
    assert [body["id"] for body, _, _ in calls] == ["request-1", "request-2", "request-3"]
    assert owner.call(prepare(4), context(), object(), [])["status"] == "ok"
    assert owner.call(prepare(5), context(), object(), [])["status"] == "deadline"
    assert [body["id"] for body, _, _ in calls] == ["request-1", "request-2", "request-3", "request-4", "request-5"]


def test_prepare_graph_deadline_is_not_evidence_for_a_later_request():
    owner, calls = owner_answering(["deadline", "ok"])
    first, second = prepare(1), prepare(2)
    first_context, second_context = context(), context()
    first_token, second_token = object(), object()
    assert owner.call(first, first_context, first_token, [])["status"] == "deadline"
    result = owner.call(second, second_context, second_token, [])
    assert result["status"] == "ok", "GRAPH_DEADLINE_REPLAY_PREVENTED_PROGRESS"
    assert result["complete"] is True
    assert calls == [(first, first_context, first_token), (second, second_context, second_token)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field,value", [("claimant", "other"), ("registry_generation", "next"), ("work_class", "background")])
def test_prepare_graph_after_deadline_passes_current_context_to_native(field, value):
    owner, calls = owner_answering(["deadline", "ok"])
    assert owner.call(prepare(1), context(), object(), [])["status"] == "deadline"
    current = context() | {field: value}
    body, token = prepare(2), object()
    registry = [{"name": "next-tool"}] if field == "registry_generation" else []
    if registry:
        owner.store.register_tool_registry = lambda registry, *, context: "next"
    result = owner.call(body, current, token, registry)
    assert result["status"] == "ok", "GRAPH_DEADLINE_REPLAY_IGNORED_CURRENT_CONTEXT"
    assert calls[-1] == (body, current, token)
